description: Generate a D&D ship using the declared prompt and optional structured fields. Entity text is free on every user plan, including Free. Portraits use the account's art preset: the default is free; a paid preset charges its Gold price, shown as portrait_gold, or falls back to the free default if unaffordable. Partner keys are billed from their wallet. Returns a job_id immediately; poll chargen_get_job for the entity_id and page_url. Pass collection_id to file it into your folder. Generated entries are public by default; change visibility in CharGen.

collection_id.description: Optional folder UUID owned by you; user accounts only. The finished entity is filed there on the first completed chargen_get_job poll.

gameMode.description: game system, e.g. D&D 5E or Starfinder 2E

idempotency_key.description: Optional partner billing deduplication key. Retries with the same key avoid a second wallet debit, but can start another generation.

kind.description: starship, station, airship, sailing_ship, astral_ship, submarine, riverboat, small_craft or other; omit to let the generator choose

partyId.description: UUID of one of your parties (chargen_list_parties)

partyRole.description: with partyId: CREW (the party crews the ship), ABOARD (passengers) or MEETING (they meet the ship)

shipClass.description: free text class, used exactly when given

size.description: small (2 decks), medium (4) or large (6); omit for 2 to 6

name: chargen_generate_ship
title: Generate ship
